quran.note: Zakariya calls on his Lord in private, saying his bones are weak, and asks for an heir.
He is given the news of Yahya, a sign of three nights’ silence, and Yahya is given judgement as a boy.
Maryam is placed in Zakariya’s care; he asks for offspring and is told of Yahya.
Zakariya asks not to be left alone; he is given Yahya, and his wife is amended for him.

hadith.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said Zakariya was a carpenter.
In the Night Journey report, the Prophet ﷺ meets Yahya and Isa in the second heaven and calls them maternal cousins.

scholarly.work: Tafsir Ibn Kathir (abridged English edition, read on Quran.com)
scholarly.author: Ibn Kathir
scholarly.summary: Says the call was secret (Qatadah) and “mawali” are the relatives who will succeed him (Mujahid, Qatadah, al-Suddi). On “inherit me”, he reasons it means prophethood, not wealth; Mujahid says knowledge, and Abu Salih says a prophet like his forefathers. He cites the report that Zakariya was a carpenter.

scholarly.work: Tafsir Ibn Kathir (abridged English edition, read on Quran.com)
scholarly.author: Ibn Kathir
scholarly.summary: On “hanan”, quotes Ibn Abbas (through Ali ibn Abi Talha), Ikrimah, Qatadah and al-Dahhak for mercy from Allah and Mujahid for gentleness. On “zakah” he gives purity, a righteous deed (Qatadah) and a pure deed (al-Dahhak, Ibn Jurayj).
